Package io.jans.lock.model.trace.entity

Class TraceReceiptEntry

java.lang.Object
io.jans.orm.model.base.Entry
io.jans.orm.model.base.BaseEntry
io.jans.lock.model.trace.entity.TraceReceiptEntry
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable
public class TraceReceiptEntry extends io.jans.orm.model.base.BaseEntry implements Serializable
A receipt-chain position allocation claim (design §9, TRACE MVP design decisions T-2, D-8). Only getReceiptState() may change after creation, via merge.

sortByName (not sortBy) so that SQL/Couchbase/Spanner order by jansTraceReceivedAtMs inside the query, before the limit, while the LDAP backend skips its in-memory default sort, which cannot handle a Long property.

Author:
Yuriy Movchan
